description: A test class for verifying the correctness and robustness of field codecs in the Orleans serialization framework. It contains various unit tests for serialization/deserialization, buffer handling, reference counting, and collection support.

classes.name: FieldCodecTester`2
classes.description: Abstract generic test class for verifying field codecs in Orleans serialization, covering various serialization scenarios and buffer handling.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounterStream
methods.description: Verifies that writing and reading fields correctly update the reference counters during stream serialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounter
methods.description: Verifies that writing and reading fields correctly update the reference counters during pipe serialization.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_StreamPooled
methods.description: Tests that values can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a pooled stream.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Span
methods.description: Tests that values can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a span.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Array
methods.description: Tests that values can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a byte array.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Memory
methods.description: Tests that values can be serialized and deserialized correctly using an on-memory sequence.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_MemoryStream
methods.description: Tests that values can be serialized and deserialized correctly using a MemoryStream.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_ReadByteByByte
methods.description: Simulates fragmented reads to verify serialization integrity on byte-by-byte deserialization.

methods.name: ProducesValidBitStream
methods.description: Verifies that serialized bit streams are valid and properly formatted.

methods.name: WritersProduceSameResults
methods.description: Ensures that different buffer writers produce identical serialized outputs.

methods.name: CanRoundTripCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies correct serialization/deserialization of collections of TValue.

methods.name: CanRoundTripWeaklyTypedCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies correct serialization/deserialization of collections of object (weakly typed).

methods.name: CanRoundTripTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Ensures tuple fields are serialized/deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer
methods.description: Checks round-trip serialization/deserialization of TValue via the Serializer.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaObjectSerializer
methods.description: Checks round-trip of TValue through the object serializer and verifies correctness.

methods.name: RoundTrippedValuesEqual
methods.description: Checks if the value round-tripped through the codec matches the original.

methods.name: CanRoundTripDefaultValueViaCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization/deserialization of default value.

methods.name: CanBeSkipped
methods.description: Verifies that a field can be skipped properly.

methods.name: TestRoundTrippedValue
methods.description: Utility method to validate a value round-trip through the codec.

methods.name: CorrectBufferHandling
methods.description: Internal helper testing buffer handling capabilities.
